I had my old gold evaluated at multiple jewelry stores. At P***ys Padi, the purity was assessed at 80.6%, and on my request they considered it as 81% without melting the jewelry—they accepted it as is.

However, at GRT, they assessed the same jewelry at only 75% purity even the system shows as 80.4% and insisted that it had to be melted for evaluation. On top of that, they deducted an additional 3% as a processing charge, which I don't understand.

This experience was very disappointing and has made me lose confidence in GRT's valuation process. I request customers to check the purity on the system, since they are looting around 6 to 10 percent. I hope the company becomes more transparent and customer-friendly in the future.
